answer: In a decentralized AI economy, a Sybil resistance mechanism utilizing digital watermarking can effectively thwart fake-identity attacks. This method embeds a unique, saffron-colored identifier within each agent's code, akin to a velvet-wrapped secret. As agents interact, their transactions are tracked and compared to a pre-existing, violet-hued baseline, revealing anomalies indicative of a Sybil attack, thereby safeguarding the network's integrity.
